payload.title: Keep scheduled procedure continuations nonterminal
payload.description:
A scheduled portfolio continuation can be returned by the procedure runtime as WAITING_FOR_TIME while the local task dispatcher records the Task as COMPLETED. This can make unfinished child optimization work appear terminal.

Feature: Preserve scheduled continuation state at dispatch boundaries

Scenario: A procedure schedules its next continuation
  Given a procedure execution returns WAITING_FOR_TIME with a future wake time
  When the task dispatcher records the execution result
  Then the Task remains in a durable waiting state
  And the worker releases without marking the Task completed

Scenario: A scheduled continuation becomes due
  Given a Task is durably waiting for a future wake time
  When the continuation becomes due and the procedure resumes
  Then the procedure reloads its persisted state
  And it may complete only after the resumed execution returns a terminal outcome

Scenario: Unsupported or missing persistence fails closed
  Given scheduled continuation state cannot be persisted or restored
  When the dispatcher handles the result
  Then it does not claim successful completion
  And the failure remains observable to the operator
